answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring economic capital to validate network operations, ensuring that the cost of spinning up fake identities remains prohibitively high. If an attacker attempts to flood the system, they face a nadir of influence unless they commit significant assets, preventing them from diluting the network like a single marble dropped into a vast ocean. This capital-intensive barrier ensures that identity is bound to financial skin-in-the-game rather than ephemeral code.
